_comment: Known-failing MUST requirements for the official a2aproject/a2a-tck suite, measured at a2a-tck 70f6f73 (the pin in .github/workflows/official-tck.yml; run 42243749206, job 127980450303, 2026-11-06). Regenerate with tck/scripts/check_conformance.py --update, then restore this note. Every entry here is an open defect tracked in docs/official-tck-findings.md and is a defect in the suite, not in this SDK; shrinking this file is the point. CORE-SEND-003 (grpc, jsonrpc, http_json): the requirement declares no expected_error, so the harness demands that a send carrying an unsupported media type succeed, contradicting its own title and A2A section 3.1.1; this SDK answers ContentTypeNotSupportedError. See section 22. HTTP_JSON-ERR-001 (http_json): the requirement text asks for the google.rpc.Status JSON representation and names no media type, but the test fails any error response whose Content-Type does not contain application/json, while the suite's own vendored A2A v1.0.1 section 11.6 example answers application/a2a+json, which this SDK sends. See sections 23 and 26. Cleared by the pin (upstream a2a-tck#258 refreshed the vendored specification and the error mappings): CORE-CANCEL-002, GRPC-ERR-002, HTTP_JSON-STATUS-001, STREAM-SUB-003 (sections 20, 21 and 25). HTTP_JSON-SVC-001 is a SHOULD at the pin and so no longer gated.
